title: Executive - Equipment Control
description:
Job Title: Executive – Equipment Control

Department: Operations

Reporting To: Manager – Operations

Direct Reports: N/A

Job Purpose:

The Executive – Equipment Control is responsible for overseeing container equipment inventory, ensuring effective coordination with depots and state agents, and maintaining accurate, real-time tracking of container movements. The role focuses on optimizing equipment utilization, planning asset allocation, resolving operational challenges, and supporting smooth logistics operations across Brazil and neighboring regions including Argentina, Uruguay, and Paraguay.

Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

Equipment Inventory Management & Planning

  • Maintain and update daily container equipment inventory statistics with high accuracy.
  • Monitor stock levels and prepare equipment allocation plans based on operational demand.
  • Analyze historical data and trends to optimize equipment availability and positioning.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure efficient equipment flow.

Depot & Vendor Coordination

  • Act as the primary liaison between container depots and state agents for equipment movements.
  • Coordinate with depot teams to track inbound and outbound container flows.
  • Resolve depot-related operational issues and monitor vendor performance to ensure service reliability.

Container Tracking & Documentation

  • Update and maintain container movement logs accurately in the tracking system.
  • Ensure data integrity and investigate discrepancies in equipment records.
  • Generate regular reports on equipment utilization, stock availability, and movement history.

Issue Resolution & Process Improvement

  • Identify and resolve equipment-related operational issues in a timely manner.
  • Work closely with Operations and Commercial teams to address inefficiencies in equipment allocation.
  • Propose process improvements to enhance tracking accuracy, turnaround time, and operational efficiency.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Maintain 100% accuracy in daily equipment inventory records, with discrepancies below 0.5% per quarter – 25%
  • Submit equipment allocation plans within 24 hours, achieving at least 95% alignment with operational demand – 20%
  • Ensure 98% on-time execution of equipment movements with minimal escalations – 20%
  • Resolve 95% of reported equipment-related issues within 24 hours – 15%
  • Ensure 100% real-time container movement updates with zero data gaps – 20%

Key Interactions:

Internal: Finance, HR & Admin, Operations, Procurement, Commercial

External: Vendors, Banks, Auditors, Statutory Authorities

Education and Experience Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Maritime Studies, Logistics, or related field
  • Specialization in Supply Chain Management, Maritime Operations, or Business Management
  • Master’s degree is preferred

Certifications & Training:

  • Professional certifications in Supply Chain Management, Maritime Operations, or Logistics (preferred)
  • Training in equipment flow optimization, compliance, and data management

Language Requirements:

  • English – Fluent
  • Portuguese – Required
  • Spanish – Optional / Advantage

Background and Experience:

Work Experience:

  • Industry: Shipping, Logistics, Freight Forwarding
  • Role Exposure: Equipment Management, Fleet Control, Logistics Coordination
  • Experience Range: 4–6 years

Core Competencies (Level 1 – Grades A–D):

  • Integrity & Accountability – Organizes work effectively, prioritizes tasks, and takes ownership of responsibilities
  • Customer Focus – Understands customer needs and ensures service delivery meets expectations
  • Continuous Learning – Actively seeks feedback, training, and applies new knowledge
  • Collaboration & Communication – Communicates clearly and supports teamwork proactively
  • Agility – Adapts to change and manages evolving operational priorities effectively

Functional Competencies:

  • Equipment Control & Management – Expertise in container inventory, allocation, and equipment flow
  • Logistics Coordination – Strong understanding of equipment movement within shipping operations
  • Data Analysis & Reporting – Ability to generate and interpret utilization and stock reports
  • Regulatory Compliance – Knowledge of industry regulations related to equipment control
  • Technology & Automation – Experience with equipment tracking systems and inventory tools

Work Environment & Specific Requirements:

  • Office-based role with regular coordination with depots, terminals, and vendors
  • Occasional travel to depots and equipment facilities as required
  • Requires strong attention to detail, coordination skills, and operational discipline

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer

We’re looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.

You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.

This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

title: Logistics & 3PL Operations Specialist
description:
About us

OPPO was founded in 2004 and is one of the global leaders in smart device innovation.

Our footprint covers more than 70 countries and regions , supported by over 300,000 sales outlets and 3,300 official service centers. We employ more than 40,000 dedicated professionals focused on creating a better life for customers worldwide through smarter products and services.

We are looking for experienced talent to join us on this exciting journey!

Responsibilities

1. Strategic Operations & 3PL Governance

  • Manage and govern the end-to-end national warehouse operations executed by 3PL partners, strategically ensuring peak efficiency in all logistics flows (inbound, outbound, and storage).
  • Oversee and optimize daily 3PL activities, implementing key metrics to maximize service levels, inventory accuracy, and processing timeliness.
  • Serve as the technical authority in high-value inventory control , establishing and maintaining rigorous protocols for IMEI/serial number tracking and reconciliation.

2. Regulatory Compliance & Auditing

  • Ensure full regulatory compliance by maintaining flawless consistency between physical goods, information systems, and complex Brazilian tax documentation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, etc.).
  • Conduct advanced, systematic auditing of 3PL adherence to SOPs and safety protocols, initiating corrective actions and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide expert advisory and practical support for NF-e invoicing , freight reconciliation, and assistance with complex ICMS tax reporting processes.

3. Project Management & Global Interface

  • Independently execute and drive key strategic logistics projects (e.g., major WMS/ERP system rollouts, warehouse network expansion) from planning through implementation.
  • Interface directly with the local Chinese team and Global Headquarters to align local operations with global supply chain strategy, acting as the primary subject matter expert in Brazil.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Accounting, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field.
  • Advanced English is mandatory (daily use).
  • Chinese is desirable.
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in Warehouse Management, 3PL Operations, or Logistics roles, with a proven track record of driving process ownership and high-impact results.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking , exceptional communication, and proven ability to operate with high autonomy and strong results-orientation.

Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level mastery of Brazilian logistics and tax legislation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, ICMS).
  • Advanced proficiency in WMS, TMS, and integrated ERP systems.
  • Demonstrated deep experience in managing and controlling high-volume, serialized inventory (IMEI/serial numbers).

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

title: Especialista de Fusões e Aquisições
description:
Somos a Copa Energia, uma empresa brasileira, referência em soluções energéticas e à frente das próximas inovações do setor para construir um amanhã melhor a partir de uma matriz energética mais limpa.

Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas ItauSA.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Fusões e Aquisições para fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Análise de oportunidades, através de mapeamento de mercado, estudos setoriais, mapeamento de targets, interação com stakeholders externos ex: assessores financeiros sell-side/buy-side, análise de tendências e articulação interna com outras áreas, garantindo sinergias e aderência estratégica com o modelo de negócios da Copa Energia;

  • Responsável por preparar materiais para tomada de decisão executiva, criando apresentações com story telling, de acordo com o público, elaborando memorandos executivos, resumos estratégicos com recomendações e/ou pontos de atenção;
  • Apoiar a coordenação de processos de due diligence (financeira, legal, ambiental, técnica etc.), identificando riscos e pontos de atenção relevantes;
  • Conduzir a integração de empresas adquiridas (PMI), liderando planos de integração operacional e estratégico, alinhando processos, pessoas e sistemas;
  • Monitoramento de performance, priorização e governança do portfólio de iniciativas estratégicas em conjunto com áreas-chave;
  • Atuar em conformidade com os pilares ESG e de integridade.

Requisitos e qualificações

title: Pessoa Supervisora de Projetos e Qualidade | Shoppings
description:
MAIS QUE MERCADO

Somos parte de um dos maiores grupos varejistas do mundo, sendo o maior varejista do Brasil e um dos maiores empregadores privado do país, com mais de 130 mil pessoas colaboradoras, unidos no propósito de contribuir para uma alimentação mais acessível e de qualidade aos brasileiros e brasileiras.

Manifesto

No Grupo Carrefour Brasil, acreditamos que a verdadeira inclusão começa com a valorização das diferenças e a criação de um ambiente onde cada pessoa pode ser autêntica e alcançar seu pleno

potencial. Aqui, cada colaborador é respeitado e incentivado a trazer sua individualidade para o trabalho.

Nossa diversidade é a força que impulsiona nosso crescimento coletivo, criando um espaço de colaboração onde todos têm a oportunidade de prosperar.

O desenvolvimento profissional é parte essencial do que oferecemos. Acreditamos que o crescimento é uma jornada contínua, e por isso fornecemos as ferramentas e oportunidades necessárias para que cada colaborador possa expandir suas habilidades e evoluir dentro da empresa. Seja por meio da escola de líderes, programas afirmativos ou vagas internas, garantimos que todos possam avançar em seu próprio ritmo, construindo uma trajetória de sucesso dentro do Grupo.

A ascensão social faz parte do nosso compromisso em transformar vidas. Valorizamos o esforço e a dedicação, oferecendo caminhos claros para o crescimento. Muitos de nossos colaboradores que iniciaram suas carreiras em posições operacionais, como estoquistas ou operadores de caixa, têm a oportunidade de, por meio de nosso apoio e desenvolvimento contínuo, alcançar cargos de supervisão, gerência e até CEO.

No Grupo Carrefour Brasil, acreditamos que o sucesso não tem limites e todos podem crescer com

dedicação e apoio. Inclusão, desenvolvimento e ascensão social caminham JUNTOS.

Aqui, você pode ser você mesmo, evoluir como profissional e transformar a sua vida e a de sua família.

Venha fazer parte dessa história!

Sobre a área:

A área de operações tem como objetivo assegurar a operação contínua e eficiente dos shoppings, por meio da excelência em manutenção, segurança, limpeza, paisagismo e estacionamento, proporcionando um ambiente seguro, acolhedor e eficiente para clientes, lojistas e colaboradores.

Desafios dessa posição:

Supervisionar as atividades de conservação, limpeza, paisagismo do mall e obras de lojistas, garantindo ambientes limpos, organizados e seguros para clientes, lojistas e colaboradores, preservando a imagem e o padrão de qualidade do empreendimento.

Gerenciar obras de novos lojistas, reformas e implantação de novos quiosques;

Coordenar e acompanhar as atividades da empresa responsável pelo paisagismo do shopping;

Assegurar que todas as obras sejam executadas com segurança, dentro dos padrões técnicos e estéticos estabelecidos;

Coordenar a equipe de limpeza e conservação, incluindo elaboração de escalas e treinamento;

Monitorar o cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais e padrões de qualidade;

Controlar o estoque e o uso de materiais de limpeza;

Avaliar a qualidade dos serviços prestados por equipes internas e fornecedores;

Reportar ocorrências, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e propor ações corretivas;

Garantir conformidade com normas ambientais, sanitárias e de segurança.

Ensino Superior Completo em Arquitetura ou Engenharia Civil;

Experiência nas áreas de limpeza, conservação e obras em Shoppings;

Experiência com gestão de equipes;

Conhecimento avançado em Autocad;

Disponibilidade para atuar nas regiões da Paulista e da Granja Julieta.

description:

  • Acompanhar, monitorar e entender os números e indicadores das empresas concorrentes e a preparação de apresentações institucionais para o público interno e externo, além de apresentações de resultados para o mercado financeiro e para o Conselho de Administração e Conselho Fiscal da Companhia;

  • Conhecer as regras de mercado de capitais, melhores práticas de governança, além de conhecimentos financeiros e do setor de atuação da Companhia.

  • Preparar apresentação de resultados para os calls de resultados conduzidos pelo Presidente e CFO; Preparação de apresentação para aprovação dos resultados nos Conselhos de Administração e Fiscal;
  • Preparação de apresentações institucionais para reuniões com analistas sell side e buy side e investidores;
  • Realizar apresentação institucional da companhia para analistas de bancos, corretoras e assets, bem como investidores e potenciais investidores;
  • Conduzir reuniões e responder as dúvidas dos investidores e analistas, bem como fornecer as informações financeiras e a participação em conferências e feita junto com os superiores;

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About WSO2

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open-source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) products. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of APIs for secure delivery of digital services and applications, enabling thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries globally to drive their digital transformation journeys. Our open-source, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in, enabling rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has over 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with nearly USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more. Follow WSO2 on LinkedIn and X (formerly Twitter).

About the Role

As a Site Reliability Engineer at WSO2, you'll be instrumental in both supporting our existing customers with their managed or private cloud deployments and initiating new deployments across leading cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Your mission will include ensuring the seamless operation, scalability, and security of WSO2 cloud services, alongside automating processes to boost both efficiency and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Deployment Setup and Management:
  • Lead the design and implementation of new cloud deployments, tailoring solutions to meet stakeholder requirements on platforms like Azure, AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes.
  • Optimize cloud architectures for scalability and cost-effectiveness, adhering to best practices for networking, security, and access controls.
  • Gain and maintain deep knowledge of cloud infrastructure providers to create robust solutions.
  • Automation and CI/CD:
  • Craft and manage automation scripts and infrastructure as code (IaC) with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
  • Deploy CI/CD pipelines to streamline software delivery, testing, and deployment processes, ensuring efficient version control and configuration management.
  • Managed Cloud Support:
  • Ensure the availability of the services by configuring system monitors and alerts and attending to critical alerts in a timely manner.
  • Offer continuous support and maintenance for existing deployments, monitoring system performance and swiftly resolving issues to maintain high availability and reliability.
  • Implement strategies for performance optimization and failure prevention, conducting thorough root cause analyses to avoid future issues.
  • Monitoring and Security:
  • Establish comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems to oversee customer deployments, setting thresholds for incident response.
  • Conduct regular security assessments and stay abreast of the latest threats and trends to fortify cloud environments against risks.
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing:
  • Foster a collaborative environment with product developers, operations, and QA teams to enhance workflows and product quality.
  • Share knowledge and best practices, contributing to the team’s collective expertise through documentation, training, and mentorship.

Skills and Experience

  • Fluent in English.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Expertise in cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and GCP.
  • Expertise in Linux, virtualization and containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • A solid understanding of networking, security principles, and compliance frameworks.
  • Proficiency in IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation), configuration management (Puppet, Chef, Helm), and scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Github Actions, Jenkins) and monitoring/logging tools (Prometheus, ELK stack, Splunk).
  • Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills, coupled with a proactive, customer-centric mindset.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We've built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it's important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual's strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

title: Merchant Operations Expert
description:
Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionise food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become a leading industry player in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansion into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching five cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arabic world to witness the speed of China.   • Quick learning ability, strong curiosity, and self-drive are important pluses;
  • Strong communication skills with experience in collaborating with various parties to advance projects;
  • Open-minded and willing to accept assignments in other countries.

What Makes This Role Exciting:

  • Participate in the growth of Brazil business from 0 to 1. 2.
  • Direct contact with the core business, establishing a comprehensive understanding of the food delivery industry and strengthening commercial analysis capabilities.

Why Join Keeta:

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.

Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 

Pré-requisitos:

  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Diferencial:

  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.

Você terá:

  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;

  • Treinamentos exclusivos;

  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.

Modo de contratação:

title: Sales Representative - Latin America (South Cone)
description:
Become Part of the Team

With over 35 years of experience, Flexicare is a leading designer and global provider of medical devices that enhance patient care. We support clinicians worldwide with class-leading devices and a global network of subsidiaries across over 100 countries. Flexicare has ambitious plans for international growth and we want you to be a part of our journey!

Job Overview

As a Sales Representative with Flexicare, you will lead the commercial development of distributor partners and drive growth across key acute care areas—including Anesthesia, Respiratory Therapy, the ICU, Pediatrics, and Emergency Services—throughout the South Cone region.

You will operate as a trusted commercial and clinical resource within hospitals, collaborating closely with distributor sales teams to strengthen engagement with key decision-makers such as physicians, respiratory therapists, biomedical engineers, nursing leaders, and supply chain professionals.

This is a highly field-focused role where you will execute sales strategies, conduct product demonstrations, and support clinical evaluations to ensure the successful adoption of Flexicare’s airway management and respiratory care solutions. You will play a critical part in expanding market presence and positioning Flexicare as a preferred partner that enhances patient outcomes and improves clinical efficiency across your assigned territory.

Want to join Flexicare? Apply today and become part of a leadership team dedicated to advancing clinical practice and elevating standards of patient care.

Territory Coverage

Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay, Bolivia, Peru

What You’ll Do

• Lead growth and execution strategies with distributors in the South Cone

• Build strong relationships with hospital decision-makers and clinical stakeholders

• Conduct product demonstrations, trainings, and clinical evaluations at customer sites

• Support new product launches tailored to local market dynamics

• Identify new business opportunities and expand penetration in existing accounts

• Coordinate pricing, contracts, purchase orders, and delivery follow-up

• Monitor competitor activity and provide structured market insights internally

• Maintain accurate CRM reporting, forecasting, and territory planning

• Represent Flexicare at regional congresses, workshops, and professional events

What You Bring

• Degree in Respiratory Therapy, Nursing, Biomedical Engineering, or similar clinical discipline

• 4+ years of medical device sales experience in Latin America

• Demonstrated success managing distributors across multiple countries

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

• High clinical credibility engaging healthcare professionals

• Fluent Spanish and English required; Portuguese strongly preferred.

• Ability to work independently with strong commercial discipline

• Availability to travel extensively across the South Cone region (>75%)

• Driven, accountable, and strategically minded

title: Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Credit Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical, organized, and hands-on professional with strong leadership skills to coordinate the areas of Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit . This is a strategic position with a structured career path toward a Finance Manager role within up to 18 months , based on performance.

Key Responsibilities

Treasury

  • Prepare and monitor daily, weekly, and projected cash flow;
  • Manage bank accounts, balances, reconciliations, and financial investments;
  • Plan fund transfers between SPVs (SPEs) and partners;
  • Support Controllership with monthly close and cash flow projections;
  • Ensure banking security, proper segregation of duties, and approval levels.

Accounts Payable

  • Coordinate the full payment cycle (review, approval, and execution);
  • Ensure accurate posting of invoices, tax withholdings, and cost centers;
  • Implement and maintain payment policies;
  • Control due dates for contracts, insurance policies, and recurring expenses;
  • Monitor advances, corporate credit cards, and payment exceptions;
  • Support financial automation initiatives and accounting integration.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Coordinate billing (rent, charges, fees, and services);
  • Monitor delinquency, aging reports, collections, and postings in the ERP;
  • Implement preventive and corrective collection policies;
  • Support negotiations with customers and legal teams when required;
  • Develop management reports by property/project.

Credit

  • Implement and continuously review the company’s credit policy;
  • Perform customer financial and credit analysis;
  • Classify customers according to risk levels;
  • Monitor delinquency indicators and credit performance;
  • Train commercial and operational teams on credit rules and processes.

Management & Strategy

  • Develop financial dashboards and performance indicators;
  • Lead continuous improvement and automation projects;
  • Act as the financial interface with partners, funds, and investors;
  • Conduct performance evaluations, develop successors, and build future leaders;
  • Act strategically alongside Controllership and Executive Management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or related fields;
  • Solid experience in Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit;
  • Experience working with financial ERP systems;
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills;
  • Leadership profile with autonomy and strategic mindset;
  • English proficiency is a plus (reading and speaking).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the real estate sector;
  • Experience managing financial flows between SPVs (SPEs);
  • Proven experience implementing financial automation.

What We Offer

  • Clear and structured career path toward a Finance Manager position;
  • Strong technical and strategic development environment;
  • Direct exposure to business financial decision-making.

Nossa gente aqui na Ambev sonha GRANDE! Somos milhares de apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Nosso maior objetivo é inovar no setor de bebidas com a maior qualidade e diversidade possível, para que você possa brindar qualquer ocasião escolhendo o que mais gosta!

Por isso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos diversos, dispostos a construir esse grande sonho com a gente de unir as pessoas por um mundo melhor.

Prazer, somos a Ambev e adoraríamos te ter com a gente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Logística/Distribuição apaixonado(a) por logística e comprometido(a) com a excelência para se juntar à nossa equipe dinâmica. Se você é uma pessoa proativa, que adora desafios e tem um olhar atento aos detalhes, essa pode ser a oportunidade perfeita para você!

- Fazer fechamento de indicadores da semana anterior e planejamento semanal de entregas.

- Realizar reunião semanal com o time comercial e acompanhar reuniões;

- Participar da reunião matinal com o time Logístico

- Fazer o fechamento de entrega do dia seguinte.

- Realizar rotas semanais, assegurando a qualidade da entrega e o nível de serviço prestado, aproximando-se dos clientes

- Realizar análises de indicadores de resultados e de processos.

- Promover análises para racionalização de atividades e de recursos.

- Implementar programas e projetos.

- Elaborar planejamentos de atividades em áreas de sua atuação.

- Elaborar e gerir planilhas eletrônicas de controle.

- Realizar treinamentos e disseminar métodos de análises.

- Adotar os procedimentos padrões e de melhoria de processos conforme programas de excelência.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo.
  • Conhecimento de Pacote Office (Excel Avançado) e em Power BI.
  • Experiência na área de Logística.

Informações adicionais

Hoje na AMBEV nós trabalhamos com os melhores benefícios para você e também para os seus dependentes legais! Aqui na companhia nós conseguimos te proporcionar:

  • Mais cuidado com a sua saúde através de Plano Médico, Odontológico, Telemedicina, Seguro de Vida e Gympass
  • Saúde mental com a Telemedicina Dasa

  • Proteção financeira com a nossa previdência privada
  • A possibilidade de você fazer um bom mercado ou comer no restaurante que você gosta com Vale Alimentação ou Refeição , pois você poderá optar por um destes benefícios
  • O vale transporte é opcional e você pode conferir no modelo da vaga
  • Ter a oportunidade de receber um abono assiduidade, que nada mais é do que o 14º salário para nossos colaboradores, um salário extra no ano!
  • Auxílio Creche ou Auxílio babá
  • Participação dos Lucros da companhia

Além de sonhar, se desenvolver, construir e crescer dentro de um ambiente meritocrático e inclusivo e ser capaz de fazer a diferença unindo as pessoas por um mundo melhor!

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Organizacional Pleno
description:
Analista de Desenvolvimento Organizacional Pleno

Como será o seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver estratégias para atrair e selecionar os melhores talentos para todas as áreas do negócio;
  • Realizar o alinhamento das posições com os requisitantes, mapeando o perfil e definindo o cronograma do processo;
  • Sugerir e implementar projetos de melhorias para o recrutamento como um todo, inclusive com a criação de novos programas de recrutamento;
  • Observar e garantir as premissas de Diversidade em nossos processos seletivos;
  • Zelar pela experiência do candidato ao longo do processo seletivo, fortalecendo a marca empregadora;
  • Participar da análise de dados e indicadores da área, estruturar os SLA's e KPI's que servirão como base para tomada de decisão;
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com a liderança, atuando como parceiro de negócio;
  • Administrar eventos corporativos para o público interno (presenciais, híbridos e online), como reuniões institucionais, workshops, treinamentos, confraternizações;
  • Conduzir e organizar a logística dos eventos (orçamentos, cronogramas, fornecedores, materiais, brindes e infraestrutura);
  • Apoiar a comunicação com áreas internas e participantes, antes, durante e após os eventos;
  • Realizar contato e acompanhamento de fornecedores (agências, buffet, audiovisual, espaços, , gráficas, entre outros);
  • Planejar a execução do calendário de endomarketing;
  • Controlar planilhas de custos, pedidos de compra e relatórios pós-evento;
  • Apoiar a elaboração de briefings, convites, listas de presença e materiais institucionais para os eventos;
  • Contribuir para a avaliação de resultados e registro de aprendizados para eventos futuros.

Requisitos e qualificações

· Graduação em Psicologia, Administração ou Recursos Humanos;

· Experiência com processos de recrutamento e seleção (entrevistas por competências, triagem de currículos e alinhamento de expectativas e prazos com a liderança);

· Vivência com elaboração de mapeamentos de candidatos e hunting estratégico no mercado;

· Experiência prévia em consultoria de seleção ou com seleção de profissionais do segmento jurídico será considerado um diferencial.

· Interesse pela área de eventos corporativos e organização de atividades institucionais;

· Conhecimento de ferramentas de R&S (LinkedIn Recruiter, Gupy);

· Conhecimento dos principais subsistemas de RH;

· Inglês;

O que buscamos:

Foco no cliente e no resultado;

Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade;

Comunicação assertiva;

Organização e gestão do tempo;

Autonomia, agilidade e curiosidade;

Postura flexível e colaborativa;

Visão de negócio.

O que oferecemos de benefícios:

Participação nos lucros;

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Building a risk applications and tools for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising the systems for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe), etc.

Responsibilities:

We are seeking a highly skilled Java Developer with experience in developing and maintaining trading applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Java, Spring Boot, SQL, Redis, and Kafka. Candidates who have experience with Order Management Systems (OMS), exchange connectivity, FIX protocol, execution algorithms will be preferred.

You will work closely with portfolio managers, traders, quants, and other technologists to build robust, scalable, and low-latency systems that support our investment and trading activities.

  • Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain core components of our Order Management and Execution Management Systems (OMS/EMS).

• Build and enhance exchange and broker connectivity including support for FIX protocol messaging and APIs.

• Work on trade lifecycle management, including order creation, routing, execution, and post-trade processes.

• Collaborate with traders and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Optimize system performance for low latency, high throughput, and fault tolerance.

• Provide level 3 support for production trading systems when necessary.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Risk & Collections team. You’ll operate with high autonomy, own critical problem areas, and deliver value that moves the needle - from credit performance to capital efficiency. This isn’t a research role. You’ll work side-by-side with engineering, product, and operations to deploy models, run experiments, and improve the core systems that decide:

  • Who gets funded
  • How and when we collect
  • Where we allocate risk capital

You’ll report to the Head of Risk and collaborate closely with our data science and engineering team. You’ll work across the entire risk lifecycle - from first impression to final repayment - applying data science to maximize portfolio performance and capital efficiency.

Your focus: deliver models and systems that make better decisions, earlier.

Specifically, you will:

  • Model borrower risk : Build and refine probability-of-default (PD) and loss-given-default (LGD) models to inform underwriting and exposure sizing.
  • Detect and prevent fraud : Develop fraud signals and real-time scoring logic to flag suspicious behaviors - from application spoofing to behavioral anomalies post-purchase.
  • Prioritize recovery actions : Predict repayment propensity and optimize collections targeting - so we know who to contact, how , and when .
  • Design experiments : Run tests across channels, messages, and strategies - not for learning’s sake, but to improve recovery, reduce loss, or increase throughput.
  • Deploy your work : Work closely with engineering to embed models and logic into our core credit and collections systems.
  • Create leverage : Equip the Risk, Credit, and Ops teams with tools, insights, and automation that scale smarter decisions.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience applying data science to business-critical problems.
  • Strong command of SQL , Python , and the practical use of ML techniques (e.g., classification, uplift modeling, time series, or embeddings).
  • Experience deploying models in production - including versioning, validation, and post-deployment monitoring.
  • Comfort working autonomously with a high bar for quality and impact.
  • Experience working with product or engineering teams to embed model logic into live systems.
  • Solid understanding of business economics: marginal value, yield, CAC/LTV, or credit-related KPIs.

Nice to have:

  • Background in lending, collections, or credit analytics.
  • Experience with experimentation frameworks or causal inference.
  • Exposure to NLP or classification techniques (e.g., message quality prediction).

Languages:

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and verbal).

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

description:

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país.   • Experiência com Microfrontends (ex.: Module Federation).
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript , Webpack , CSS-in-JS .
  • Autenticação JWT com OAuth2, SAML (desejável)
  • Arquitetura:

  • Integração contínua, pipelines de build/deploy.
  • Testes automatizados (unitários, integração, end-to-end).
  • Monitoramento e escalabilidade.

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.

Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.

Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: Technical Procurement Specialist
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role

As a senior Technical Procurement Specialist at Vammo, you will be responsible in managing the procurement process for technical materials and services that are crucial to our product lineup. You will collaborate with various teams to identify needs, source components, negotiate contracts with our suppliers, and ensure that our purchasing decisions are optimized for both quality and cost-effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and evaluate potential suppliers for components and parts essential to our products.
  • Assess suppliers based on their quality standards, pricing, and delivery capabilities to secure optimal partnerships.
  • Negotiate terms and conditions and manage the procurement process.
  • Monitor service level agreements (SLAs) to ensure timely delivery and compliance with quality standards.
  • Work closely with engineering and project management teams to align on technical requirements and specifications.

Hard Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or related fields.
  • Proven expertise in technical sourcing and procurement processes.
  • Proficiency in utilizing procurement software and tools.
  • Familiarity with the dynamics of the two-wheeler market.
  • Advanced English proficiency for effective drafting and communication.

Soft Skills

  • Clarity and Precision:  Communicates directly and escalates critical issues effectively.
  • Critical Thinking:  Questions assumptions and understands the context before making informed decisions.
  • Disciplined Curiosity:  Learns quickly, asks insightful questions, and applies acquired knowledge.
  • Ownership Mindset:  Engages with every task as a contribution to the company’s overall success.
  • Process-Oriented Thinking:  Analyzes workflows to enhance efficiency and outcomes.
  • Negotiation Skills:  Demonstrates effective negotiation skills to achieve favorable supplier agreements.

The Economist will play a vital role in supporting our sales pipelines, driving client engagement, and producing data-driven insights that impact on our target markets.

About ISI Markets:

As Vendry’s Developer, you’ll be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the core technical infrastructure that powers the Vendry platform. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership across frontend, backend, and internal tooling.

You’ll manage everything from our public-facing website and landing pages to our agency portal and proprietary agency search engine. You’ll work closely with the founding team to ship features quickly, improve performance and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of the product.

This is an ideal role for a developer who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys autonomy, and is excited to build and iterate fast.

⸻

Responsibilities

• Own and manage Vendry’s full technical stack, including:

• Frontend website and marketing landing pages

• Agency portal and internal tools

• Proprietary agency search and matchmaking engine

• Build, ship, and maintain new features across the product with a focus on speed, quality, and scalability.

• Ensure the platform is reliable, performant, and secure as usage grows.

• Collaborate closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Stay up to date on modern development trends, tools, and best practices.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve velocity and code quality.

• Troubleshoot issues across the stack and proactively improve system architecture.

• Document technical decisions and maintain clean, readable codebases.

⸻

Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience as a software developer or engineer.

• Experience working in a startup environment is a must.

• Strong experience with modern frontend and backend development.

• Comfortable owning projects end-to-end, from idea to production.

• Familiarity with databases, APIs, and search or filtering systems is a plus.

• Experience building or maintaining SaaS products or internal platforms is strongly preferred.

• Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and clear written communication.

⸻

Compensation

• Salary: $2,000–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and scope.

• Full-time, remote role.

⸻

Why Join Vendry

Joining Vendry means having real ownership over a product that’s redefining how brands find agency partners. You won’t be maintaining a tiny slice of a massive codebase—you’ll be shaping the foundation of a growing platform.

  • We’re a small, fast-moving team that values initiative, clarity of thinking, and building practical solutions that actually get used. If you enjoy shipping, iterating, and seeing your work directly impact the business, you’ll feel right at home.

  • Ambientes Linux .

  • Organização e documentação técnica .

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we’re the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America , partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.

  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone

Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.

In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.

Nice to have:

  • Golang experience

This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Senior Cloud SRE
description:
Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer

As a Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer , you will join a specialized engineering task force dedicated to preventing and resolving the most critical and strategic customer issues encountered in the field.

Our global team of experienced engineers has a deep understanding of the lower layers of private cloud infrastructure. Together, we work on practical solutions, continuously learning and adapting. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and tackle challenges head-on.

If you're an engineer eager to understand the core of cloud technologies and looking for a team that values hands-on expertise , you'll fit right in with us.

What you will learn and contribute to

  • Maintain and enhance Red Hat private cloud: You’ll work extensively with Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS) , private cloud solutions based on Kubernetes and OpenStack .
  • Deep Dive Troubleshooting: Starting from high-level Kubernetes error messages, you’ll navigate through multiple layers until pinpointing issues—even down to kernel-level bugs.
  • Automate and Develop: Spend 30–50% of your time developing automation to prevent recurring issues. Solve it once, automate for the future. Use your Python skills to create health checks and improve reliability.
  • Continuous Learning: In our rapidly evolving tech landscape, ongoing learning is a cornerstone.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Engineers: Work closely with developers and product engineers to bridge infrastructure and software, ensuring seamless product delivery.
  • Mode of Operation: This role requires participation in a follow-the-sun scheme with 12-hour shifts (within regulatory limits) or participation in on-call rotations to ensure business continuity during emergencies.

Your skills and experience

  • Linux Expertise: Strong familiarity with Linux distributions; we primarily use Red Hat and CentOS .
  • Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VLANs, IP routing). Experience with Calico , Multus , and Open vSwitch is a plus.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills and analytical thinking to address complex challenges.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Bash and Python , or willingness to learn, plus familiarity with Ansible .
  • Containerization & Virtualization: Knowledge of Podman , Kubernetes , Helm , and/or OpenStack ; experience with KVM/QEMU is advantageous.
  • Storage Systems: Experience with Ceph and Rook is highly valued.
  • Database Expertise: Understanding of relational databases ( MySQL , MariaDB ) and experience with etcd .
  • Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with tools like ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) , Prometheus , and Grafana .
  • Advanced written and spoken English.

It would be nice if you also had

  • Proactive thinking and ownership mindset.
  • Strong focus on quality and reliability.
  • Passion for delivering training or knowledge-sharing sessions to operations teams.

Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Sobre a vaga

Acompanhar os planejamentos e agendamentos de implantações de software, incluindo readiness reviews e marcos de entrega.

Apoiar a governança das implantações em modelo presencial ou remoto, conforme criticidade.

Disponibilidade para atuar eventualmente fora do horário comercial (finais de semana em casos críticos).

title: Desenvolvedor JAVA com Automação
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Código da oportunidade: 57092

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve saber?

Você fará parte do time responsável por um aplicativo iOS em evolução contínua, com exigência de robustez, consistência e excelência em experiência. Atuação em squad com Produto, Design e Engenharia, com forte cultura de qualidade.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em Java (obrigatório)
  • Experiência em Appium para testes automatizados (obrigatório)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Jira, Xray, GitHub
  • Experiência com Sauce Labs (Device Farm) será um diferencial
  • Vaga híbrida em São Paulo- SP

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Supervisor (a) Florestal - Proteção Florestal
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais Atividades:

  • Gerir pessoas, distribuindo tarefas, acompanhando desempenho e promovendo treinamentos contínuos;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança, conduta e procedimentos internos;
  • Elaborar e atualizar planos de prevenção de incêndios;
  • Coordenar brigadas em situações de emergência e definir estratégias de combate;
  • Planejar e executar atividades preventivas e monitoramento patrimonial;
  • Utilizar sistemas de vigilância (câmeras, drones, aplicativos) para inspeções e controle das áreas;
  • Monitorar pragas, doenças e infraestrutura rural, apoiando ações de conservação ambiental;
  • Aproximar-se das comunidades vizinhas, apoiando demandas sociais e mediando conflitos;
  • Controlar checklists, manutenção e indicadores de frota, assegurando uso adequado dos equipamentos;
  • Gerir bases aéreas, equipes helitransportadas e contratos de empresas aéreas.
  • Planejar recursos financeiros, humanos e materiais, assegurando a melhor logística.
  • Acompanhar indicadores (KPI’s), aprovar pagamentos e participar de auditorias, garantindo conformidade legal.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência comprovada em monitoramento, segurança patrimonial e combate a incêndios florestais;
  • CNH B - definitiva;
  • Disponibilidade para residir em Cassilândia / MS.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:

You’ll work closely with Product, Marketing, and Engineering teams to deliver elegant, scalable solutions that drive engagement and business growth.
